seattle.aiText: Current conditions are slightly cooler and wetter than the 30-year climate normal for this time of year. The dominant low-pressure system off the coast is driving continuous maritime moisture into the region.

warning.title: Severe Thunderstorm Warning
warning.desc: Active until 4:00 PM EDT. Expect wind gusts up to 60mph and heavy downpours.

miami.aiText: Temperatures are tracking above the historical baseline. Elevated atmospheric instability is triggering severe convective activity.

london.aiText: A standard overcast day. Conditions are stable with no significant precipitation expected in the next 24 hours.
